ExtraBar 1.2.2 – Your Bookmarks, Always Within Reach! 🔖✨

Check Out Shiori Bookmark Manager

✨ What's New – Shiori Bookmark Manager Integration

  • Bookmark Widget: Access your entire Shiori bookmark library right from your menu bar! Search, browse folders, and open bookmarks without leaving your workflow!
  • Full Bookmark Manager: A dedicated window to organize your bookmarks – create folders, manage tags with color coding, and bulk-edit your library with ease!
  • Quick Add & Edit: Add new bookmarks with Cmd+, edit details inline, copy URLs with one click, and delete bookmarks – all from the widget!
  • Folder Navigation: Browse your bookmark folders with full subfolder support and smooth keyboard navigation!
  • Smart Search & Filters: Find any bookmark instantly by keyword, folder, or tag – your library is always organized!

📥 Import & Export

  • Import From Anywhere: Bring in bookmarks from browser HTML exports, JSON files, Raindrop.io, Pocket, and Pinboard!
  • Export Your Way: Export your bookmarks to JSON, CSV, or browser-compatible HTML – your data, your choice!

🔄 Offline & Sync

  • Offline Access: Full access to your bookmarks even without an internet connection – cached locally for instant loading!
  • Background Sync: Automatic synchronization with configurable intervals and smart network reconnect detection!
  • Pending Changes: Offline edits are preserved and synced when you're back online!

🔐 Account & Subscription

  • Keyper Authentication: Sign in with your Keyper account for streamlined registration and login!
  • Deep Link Login: Authenticate directly from the Shiori website into ExtraBar – seamless and secure!
  • Subscription Management: View your plan, usage limits, and upgrade options right from Settings!

🔧 Other Improvements

  • Bookmark Manager Menu Item: Quick access from the application menu!
  • Improved Keyboard Navigation: Better focus handling in bar content!
  • Enhanced Popover Handling: Smoother bookmark widget popovers in bar and menu bar modes!
  • Theme Switcher: Toggle between System, Light, and Dark appearance for the bookmark popover!

🚀 What's Next?

We're excited to bring Shiori integration to ExtraBar! More integrations and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
